channel.title: CIS 260 - Foundations of Relational Databases :: CS Two Year Refactor
channel.description: Course Description This 1‑credit hour course introduces students to Structured Query Language (SQL) for retrieving and analyzing data in relational databases. Students will learn to write basic queries to select, filter, summarize, and combine data from multiple tables using hands‑on exercises and real‑world examples. Credit Hours 1 credit Course Overview The objective of this course is to provide students with the foundations to understand simple relational databases. With this knowledge, students will be able to understand and write SQL queries to find, organize, and summarize information from real-world datasets.
